lines.2: 「So Ellie is going to betray me.」
lines.5: 「I-I'm not betraying you, okay? I admit I'm being selfish, but there's no way I'd ever betray you, Yoppi!」
lines.6: 「You introduced me to the boy you'd thrown away, I worked up the courage to confess, and just when I thought I could be happy with Tsushima... you do this?」
lines.7: 「Well, I... But it isn't betrayal. That's not what this is.」
lines.8: 「You went out of your way to give me hope, and now you're trying to take it away!」
lines.9: 「That is betrayal. Don't twist it into something convenient for yourself.」
lines.12: 「Surprised? Well, I was far more surprised than that.」
lines.13: 「Because it was you, Ellie. Hearing something like that from you...」
lines.14: 「I had no idea you liked Tsushima that much...」
lines.15: 「...Yoppi. I know I'm the one at fault this time, but...」
lines.16: 「you can't keep assuming the worst like that.」
lines.17: 「I know you're selfish, Ellie. I don't even mind that about you.」
lines.18: 「But we swore, remember? We made our charm together. After everything I did, you're really going to be that selfish even with me...?」
lines.19: 「I love you so much, Ellie. Are you going to betray me?」
lines.20: 「I keep telling you, that's not it! Stop sulking and saying things like that.」
lines.21: 「You're the one making me say them, Ellie. That's so cruel...」
lines.24: 「Ellie... you aren't really going to betray me, are you? You were only saying it, right?」
lines.26: 「Ellie... I went too far throwing coffee on you... Here, let me wipe it off.」
lines.28: 「This was just a little misunderstanding. Tomorrow... No, starting right now, we'll go back to how we always were, won't we?」
lines.29: 「There's nothing to go back to. I've loved you from the beginning, Yoppi. I still do.」
